newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Seventeen killed in Brazil bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Seventeen killed in Brazil bus crash.

text.p: Seventeen people were killed and 26 injured in a head-on collision on Thursday between a bus carrying carnival revellers going home and a truck in northern Rio de Janeiro state, police said.
The truck driver and two bus drivers were among those killed in the crash 46 miles (74 km) north of Campos.
The bus was heading to Rio de Janeiro city from Porto Seguro in the northeastern state of Bahia, a seaside resort and centre for annual carnival celebrations.
